description:
We are BioPulse Ai !! We have Full-stack web dev, active-listening UI, and Autonomous Agentic AI capabilities covered. We are building an intelligent health & biometrics monitoring platform for astronauts on deep space missions. 

We are specifically looking for teammates with a strong background in Astrophysics, Space Medicine, Human Factors, or Earth & Space Science datasets to help us ground our AI models in real space telemetry and domain expertise!
summary: ASTRO-SENTINEL is an "Offline-First 3D Holographic Astronaut Digital Twin" and "Autonomous Edge AI Flight Surgeon" designed to protect crew health during deep-space missions where communication delays to Earth reach up to 24 minutes one-way (44 minutes round-trip). Built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, it integrates real-time solar flare and geomagnetic storm telemetry from the NASA CCMC DONKI API alongside NASA Human Research Program's (HRP) five spaceflight hazards and a 180-day Mars transit simulator with dynamic compound hazard coupling. Crew members can inspect clickable BRAIN, HEART, and SPINE organ nodes on an interactive 3D bio-rig and receive immediate, 3-step clinical triage guidance via voice or text—powered by a resilient multi-LLM fallback chain (OpenRouter, Gemini, Grok) when online and a zero-latency, deterministic 12-protocol NASA HRP clinical engine when offline, backed by a 500-slot Black-Box ring buffer that syncs automatically upon Deep Space Network reconnection.
details:
What It Does & How It Works:

ASTRO-SENTINEL is an Autonomous onboard medical command cockpit engineered for long-duration spaceflight (such as Mars transits), where 44-minute round-trip signal latency and Deep Space Network (DSN) blackouts make real-time Earth flight-surgeon intervention impossible during acute emergencies.

1. Interactive 3D Holographic Digital Twin (React Three Fiber / WebGL):

- Renders a real-time bio-rig mesh with clickable BRAIN, HEART, and SPINE organ nodes that shift visually across Nominal, Monitoring, and Critical states.

- Displays real-time physiological telemetry sparklines including Heart Rate (BPM), SpO2 (%), Core Body Temperature (°C), Sleep Recovery, and Bone Mineral Density.

2. Live NASA CCMC DONKI Space-Weather & 180-Day Mars Transit Simulator:

- Fetches live solar flare (FLR) and geomagnetic storm (GST / Kp-index) alerts directly from the NASA CCMC DONKI API, with a "Trigger Solar Storm" contingency mode for emergency drills.

- Models all five NASA Human Research Program (HRP) hazards—Space Radiation, Isolation & Confinement, Distance from Earth, Altered Gravity Fields, and Hostile/Closed Environments—with a dynamic 1.20x–1.35x Compound Hazard Coupling engine across a 180-day Mars transit timeline.

3. Hybrid Autonomous AI Flight Surgeon (Online Multi-LLM + 0ms Offline Edge AI):

- Online Mode (Earth DSN Sync): Routes crew symptoms, live vitals, and space-weather telemetry through a resilient 3-provider LLM fallback chain (OpenRouter -> Google Gemini -> xAI Grok) for real-time clinical reasoning.

- Offline Mode (Edge Triage): Operates with 0 ms network latency during comms blackouts using a deterministic, zero-hallucination 12-protocol NASA HRP clinical triage engine (covering SANS/neuro-ocular fluid shifts, post-EVA orthostatic dizziness, CO2 headache, tachycardia, hypoxia, acute Solar Particle Event radiation, spinal unloading, and dehydration) with Web Speech voice input and spoken audio readout.

4. 500-Slot Offline Black-Box Ring Buffer & DSN Sync:

- Persists every triage event and physiological snapshot locally in a 500-slot Black-Box ring buffer (QUEUED) while offline and automatically reconciles all records with Earth Mission Control (SYNCED) once DSN connectivity returns.

- Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used:

- Frontend & 3D Visualization: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Three Fiber (Three.js), Web Speech API.

- Backend & AI Architecture: Next.js Edge/Serverless API Routes, NASA CCMC DONKI REST API, Multi-LLM Fallback Chain (OpenRouter, Google Gemini, xAI Grok), and a deterministic 12-protocol NASA HRP TypeScript clinical engine.

- Hosting & Verification: Deployed on Vercel with 43/43 automated end-to-end tests passed.

Intended Impact & Creativity:

- Deep-Space Exploration: Empowers Artemis and Mars crews with immediate, self-contained medical decision support independent of Earth latency.

- Earth Spin-Offs: Directly applicable to remote rural clinics, Antarctic research stations, submarines, and disaster-relief zones experiencing severe connectivity outages.

- Data Transparency: Clearly distinguishes live NASA DONKI space-weather telemetry from deterministic crew-vital simulations, never misrepresenting simulated physiology as real astronaut flight data.

Code Repository & AI Assistance Disclosure:

- Open-Source GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Fatimahnoman/Astro-Sentinel

- AI/SI Disclosure: Built using OpenCode CLI, Claude, and Gemini for code scaffolding, UI/UX refinement, automated testing, and slide structuring; runtime online triage uses OpenRouter, Google Gemini, and xAI Grok APIs alongside our deterministic offline NASA HRP protocol engine.
